finding.text: The diff writes false "gone" lines into eleven unrelated `files.jsonl` indexes (Requirements, the indexing check). The worktree has no copies of gitignored files, so its indexer marked them gone, e.g. `ai/files.jsonl` +`usage.json`/`tasks.json`/`index.jsonl` gone, `ai/sessions/files.jsonl` +`week.json` gone, `ai/whisper/files.jsonl` +`2026-10-09.jsonl` gone. All of these still exist in the main tree (`ls` finds `ai/usage.json`, `ai/tasks.json`, `ai/sessions/week.json`, `ai/whisper/2026-10-09.jsonl`). Commit by path: keep only `ext/Chat/files.jsonl`, `ext/Chat/v1-2/**/files.jsonl` and `core/Session/Chat/files.jsonl`, and drop the rest.

Ask 2's "live Whisper guess" never sits after the cursor. `ChatV1Dot2.entries()` draws only the sentences in `V1Bubbles.events` (ended sentences). The interim guess and the unfinished sentence are not drawn, and the test never feeds one. Either draw the interim words after the ✓, or record in `v1-2/readme.md` Decisions that they are out of scope and why.

`ai/system-map.md:59` is now stale: it says "the Chat tab has three chips". The diff adds a fourth (Chat V1.2, `AISessionDetail.js`), but the map and its versions table (lines 23–42) don't mention V1.2. Add one row and one line.

Ask 3 asked for "dims a little when a sentence is sent, lights green when the assistant has received it". The build has a single stamp (`sent.fast.at`), so the ✓ moves only on receipt and stays dim while later ended sentences wait. This reading is written down in the readme's Decisions with its alternative, so it is fine to land. The owner should still see it when trying it out.

Ask 1 said "a subclass that swaps the source". `ChatV1Dot2 extends JSONL` wraps V1's `chat()` and does not subclass it. That's reasonable because V1 is a function bag, and the readme says so. V1 really is untouched: the diff has no `Chat.js` or `Chat.css` hunk.

In the demo, the unsent sentence "Try a hard refresh." lands in its own owner bubble below the Reply, not after the ✓ in the first bubble (`shots/…-v1-2/400.png`, band 3). This is V1's ordering rule at work, but the cursor then looks as if it ends the conversation's owner text. A fixture with no Reply mid-Prompt would show the ask more clearly.

The walkthrough's shots are under the gitignored `**/shots/` (`.gitignore:210`). The links in `walkthrough.md` will be dead for anyone not on this machine. The walkthrough says so and gives the regenerate command.
New classes `ChatV1Dot2` and `SendCursor` (state: `on`, the cursor's position) have no page showing their live instances (rules.md "Show the class, and its live instances").
The dim ✓ sits at opacity .35 on the pink owner bubble, which makes it hard to see (`shots/…-v1-2/400.png`, "Maybe it is the cache. ✓"). That's intended for "dim", but .5 would still read as a check.

Ask 1, "add it to the list so we can try it out": V1.2 is in `ext/Chat/page.js` children and has a chip on the session page, but it is missing from the version dropdown where V1, V2 and V3 sit (`ext/drawer/ChatView.js` `static VERSIONS`, the ✦ sheet and the drawer). That dropdown is the only place with a live composer, so it is the only place the owner can watch the cursor and the live draft (the `chat-live` event) while dictating.

`ai/AISession/readme.md` is now out of date: line 10 and line 24 both still say the Chat tab has "three chips", and neither mentions Chat V1.2 or `?chat_view=v1-2`. The diff changed `AISessionDetail.js` but not this readme (law 9).
`ai/system-map.md` §3b now says "four chips (Chat, Chat V1.2, Chat v2, Chat v3)", but the rest of the sentence only explains three of them. Add "Chat V1.2 mounts `ChatV1Dot2` on `session.jsonl`".

The review shots of `/framework/ext/Chat/v1-2/` (`400.png`, band 3) show the older look: the owner's avatar sits in each pill and the Reply has a grey bubble. The builder's own `shots/v1-2-360.png` shows the Claude-style layout from `bubbles.css`, which the branch contains (`Chat.js:8`). The shot server most likely served stale CSS. Before merging, check the demo page by eye.

The demo fixture still puts the unsent "Try a hard refresh." in its own bubble below the Reply (`400.png`, band 3). V1's rule closes a bubble once a Reply lands, so this is by design and the builder accepted it. Even so, the ✓ looks as though it ends the owner's turn.

"Dims when sent, lit when received" is built as "dim while ended sentences wait". It is a documented decision with the alternative named (v1-2/readme.md, Decisions). Ask 1's "subclass" is a wrap, because V1 is a function bag; that is also documented.

The walkthrough's three screenshots will not survive: `walkthrough.md` links `shots/v1-2-360.png`, `shots/demo-360.png`, `shots/demo-1920.png`, and `.gitignore:210` (`**/shots/`) ignores all three, so the outcome's walkthrough is three dead links on any other machine (Requirements, Check 3; law 5, "files survive"). chat-layout fixed the same problem today by committing its shots under `doc/` (commit f0dce6390); do the same here.

`ext/drawer/readme.md` is out of date: the `ChatView.js` line now lists V1.2 in the dropdown but still says "the Chat v2 / Chat v3 box it switches on" and that `lew42.sheet.chat_view` holds "none for V1, "v2" or "v3"". `ChatView.js:22` now also accepts `"v1-2"` (law 9).

`core/Session/Chat` is out of date: its readme (line 94) and `doc/pseudo-properties.md:48` say `V1Bubbles.js` is a "read-only tool, not a migration". It now feeds a live view, `ext/Chat/v1-2/ChatV1Dot2.js`, and neither doc names V1.2 as a consumer. A change to the adapter would now change V1.2's drawing without warning (law 9, law 10).

`ux/Dictate/doc/status-icons.md`, the doc that explains "the green check and the brain icon", still describes only the two-mark V1 behaviour (a ✓ going gray then green, plus a 🧠). It has no line saying that V1.2 draws one ✓ that is dim while words wait and green once caught up, with no 🧠, and no link to `ext/Chat/v1-2/readme.md`. A reader who looks up the marks gets the wrong answer for V1.2.

Carried over from the last review: `ai/system-map.md` §3b says "four chips (Chat, Chat V1.2, Chat v2, Chat v3)", but the rest of the sentence explains only Chat, v2 and v3. It still needs "Chat V1.2 mounts `ChatV1Dot2` on `session.jsonl`".

The ✓ is hard to see. It is a pale gray-green at 0.55 opacity on the pink bubble (`shots/127-0-0-1-60184-framework-ext-Chat-v1-2/400.png`, band 3, after "Maybe it is the cache."), likely under 3:1. Even lit, in `shots/v1-2-360.png`, it is a thin glyph that reads gray rather than green (colour 1).

The Reply still carries a pink brain avatar (`400.png`, band 3, "Looking at the build now."). The ask removed the 🧠 *mark* that rides after the owner's words, and that is gone. But the owner's words were "no pink brain", so they may expect this avatar gone too. Worth one line in the readme's Decisions.

The demo's unsent "Try a hard refresh." sits in its own bubble below the Reply (`400.png`, band 3). This follows V1's rule that a Reply closes the owner's bubble. It was accepted last round, but it means the "words after the cursor" can sit below the assistant's reply rather than in the same bubble.

Stale doc, ext/drawer: `ChatView.js`'s class comment (diff line 573–575) still says "V2 or V3 swaps the chat's bubbles…" and "gets .drawer-rail-sheet-v2-on while v2 shows", and `ext/drawer/readme.md`'s `Sheet.js` bullet still ends "The version dropdown in the sheet's head shows Chat v2 (`ChatV2`) in place of the bubbles". Both now have four versions; name V1.2 (and V3) or say "the version picked".
Stale wording in the empty state: `ChatView.js` `Say something: Chat ${this.mode} draws…` now prints "Chat v1-2", not the name the dropdown shows ("V1.2"). Read the name from `VERSIONS`.

Requirement 3, "no pink brain": the Reply still shows a pink 🧠 avatar (`shots/demo-360.png`, band 3; `ext/Chat/roles.js:17` `smart: "🧠"`). The builder kept it on purpose and says so under Pictures in the readme; move that to the readme's Decisions with the alternative (a V1.2-only avatar, e.g. the plain `assistant` 💬), since the owner will read "no pink brain" literally.

Requirement 2: a sentence still waiting does not sit in the owner's bubble after the ✓; V1's time-ordering puts "Try a hard refresh." in its own bubble below the Reply (`shots/demo-360.png`), and the live guess is a separate draft pill (`shots/v1-2-360.png`). Order is right (after the ✓), placement is V1's. Fine for a try-out; say it in the readme.

The review shots are stale: `shots/<page>/400.png` still shows the old intro ("the grey sentences after it… Pass ?src=…"), while the diff's `page.js` says "the faded sentence after it is on its way. To see a real session, add ?src=…". The server served an old `page.js`; every `layout.json` also logs a 404 at each width. Judge the look by `ext/Chat/v1-2/doc/*.png`.
New classes `ChatV1Dot2` and `SendCursor` have a demo page but no view of a live instance's properties (`split()`'s received/waiting would be the one to show).
